quotes.author: Blaise Pascal

quotes.author: Blaise Pascal

quotes.author: Blaise Pascal

quotes.author: Blaise Pascal

quotes.author: Blaise Pascal
quotes.quote: If you talk about love enough, you end up falling in love

quotes.author: Blaise Pascal
quotes.quote: What good is it for a man to gain the whole world if he loses his soul?

quotes.author: Blaise Pascal

quotes.author: Blaise Pascal
quotes.quote: Description of the man: dependence, desire for independence, need.

quotes.author: Blaise Pascal
quotes.quote: When it comes to religion, we must be sincere: true pagans, true Jews, true Christians

quotes.author: Blaise Pascal

quotes.author: Blaise Pascal
quotes.quote: Morality is the science par excellence; it is the art of living well and being happy

quotes.author: Blaise Pascal
quotes.quote: He who believes he is right about everything is ignorant of the true nature of things

quotes.author: Blaise Pascal
quotes.quote: Conscience is the best moral guide we have

quotes.author: Blaise Pascal
quotes.quote: The queen of the world is power, not opinion; but it is opinion that wields power

quotes.author: Blaise Pascal
quotes.quote: Our nature is in motion. Absolute stillness is death.

quotes.author: Blaise Pascal
quotes.quote: If we’re always ready to be happy, it’s inevitable that we’ll sometimes not be

quotes.author: Blaise Pascal

quotes.author: Blaise Pascal
quotes.quote: Neither is a contradiction an indication of falsehood, nor is the absence of contradiction an indication of truth

quotes.author: Blaise Pascal
quotes.quote: We never actually live; instead, we wait to live. And since we are always preparing to be happy, it is inevitable that we will never be so.

quotes.author: Platón
quotes.quote: It is not the eyes that see, but what we see through the eyes

quotes.quote: We must look for a cause of our troubles other than God

quotes.quote: No human cause deserves such anxiety

quotes.quote: Love is feeling the sacred essence beating within your loved one

quotes.quote: Honesty often yields less profit than lying

quotes.quote: Good deeds give us strength and inspire others to do good as well

quotes.author: Platón
quotes.quote: When a mob exercises authority, it is even more cruel than tyrants

quotes.author: Rene Descartes

quotes.author: Rene Descartes

quotes.author: Rene Descartes

quotes.author: Rene Descartes

quotes.author: Rene Descartes

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
